name: Coal LSL payroll levy: prescribed percentage of eligible wages

basis.instrument: Coal Mining Industry (Long Service Leave) Payroll Levy Regulations 2018
basis.provision: s 6 (Rate of levy), made for s 5 of the Coal Mining Industry (Long Service Leave) Payroll Levy Act 1992

advice_status: Not advice. Verify each figure against its primary source at the time of use.

primary_source.title: Coal Mining Industry (Long Service Leave) Payroll Levy Regulations 2018, Compilation No. 1
primary_source.compilation: F2023C00557 (compilation date 1 July 2023, registered 7 July 2023, includes amendments up to F2023L00772)
primary_source.passage: s 6: For the purposes of section 5 of the Act, 2.7% is the prescribed percentage of the eligible wages paid. s 8: the amendment made by the Coal Mining Industry (Long Service Leave) Payroll Levy Amendment Regulations 2023 applies in relation to eligible wages paid on or after 1 July 2023.

rows.verified_by: automated retrieval, 5 November 2026 (first read 18 September 2026); no professional review recorded
rows.verification_note: The compilation shows s 6 as amended by F2023L00772 (commenced 1 July 2023). The rate text in force before 1 July 2023 was not read in this session, so no row covers earlier months. Rechecked 5 November 2026: the Register shows Compilation No. 1 as the latest version, with no unincorporated amendment and no later amending instrument, and Coal LSL's levy page states a current rate of 2.7%. A later compilation supersedes this row; check the Register before relying on it.
